 #define SAFNUM_BGP_LS          71  /* RFC7752 */

 #define SAFNUM_ROUTE_TARGET   132  /* RFC 4684 Constrained Route Distribution for BGP/MPLS IP VPN */

-
+#define SAFNUM_FSPEC_RULE     133  /* RFC 8955 BGP flow spec SAFI */
